displayName: OCI-WSTG04-001: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
description:
Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%credentials%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%transmitted%') AND "value" > 0
